q: Which sentence is the best summary?
o: Both hand a dependency in instead of creating it; Depends() is how FastAPI does it for routes
Depends() is a different thing from injection
Constructor injection only works in tests
why: They are the same idea in two places: constructors in your own classes, Depends() at the edge where FastAPI builds things for a request.
